Description

IT Data Analyst

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Primary Roles and Responsibilities: -

Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, including joins and Common Table Expressions (CTEs), for data extraction and transformation.
Proven ability to lead client engagements and present complex findings.
Able to work independently without the needs for close supervision and collaboratively as part of cross team efforts
Extremely strong organizational and analytical skills with strong attention to details
Ensure business logic and data quality checks are implemented and functioning correctly within ADF and Databricks pipelines.
Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues by conducting detailed root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions.
Ensure timely data delivery by tracking system performance and proactively addressing issues within defined SLAs.
Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders to support operational and analytical data needs.
Maintain strong documentation practices to ensure continuity and clarity across the team.
Work closely with Azure DevOps for CI/CD and understand release processes (Dev to Ops Handover) and have experience on release management.
Understand data integrations with third-party platforms such as Veeva CRM and Salesforce.
Provide support during shift hours as per business requirements in EST time zones.
Communicate effectively within team and across departments to align on objectives and tasks.

Preferred Qualifications: -

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field.
2–4 years of professional experience in data analysis, data engineering, or ETL processes.
Must hold an Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) certification.
Databricks certifications are highly desirable.
Experience with root cause analysis and troubleshooting in production environments.
Strong communication, collaboration, and teamwork skills.

Technical Skills: -

Primary Skills:
Azure Data Factory
Azure Databricks
Azure Data Lake Gen2(ADLS)
SQL
Python/PySpark

Secondary Skills: -
Unity Catalog
Lakehouse Architecture

Nice to Have: -
Salesforce
JIRA
Azure Logic Apps
Azure Key Vault
Azure Automation Account

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically proficient IT Data Analyst to join our team in a remote capacity. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Data Engineering or ETL processes with hands-on experience in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and SQL. This role will support business-critical data integration and operational processes, ensuring smooth pipeline execution, system reliability, and timely data delivery. The analyst will also collaborate with stakeholders across IT and business functions to resolve issues, implement improvements, and ensure data integrity across platforms like Veeva CRM, Salesforce, and Azure-based data systems

jobs.title: Data Analyst Assistant
jobs.description:
Alpine Business Consulting is looking for a Data Analyst Assistant to support our ongoing project with an Antwerp-based logistics client. In this entry-level role, you will work alongside our consultants to maintain the integrity of financial data within Enterprise Performance Management systems. The position is fully remote, allowing you to contribute to complex international projects from your own workspace.

About Alpine Business Consulting

Alpine Business Consulting works at the intersection of finance processes and the systems that support them. We specialize in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) and analytics, helping finance teams fix platforms that never delivered on their promises. While we build new systems from scratch, much of our work involves remediating existing setups in Oracle EPM, SAP BPC, and Power BI. We focus on the numbers side of the house, ensuring that consolidation rules, intercompany eliminations, and reporting pipelines reflect how a finance team actually operates.
Our approach moves away from typical implementation theatre. We prioritize finance-first configurations and fixed-price engagements, giving our clients certainty before any work begins. We do not believe in keeping clients dependent on us. Instead, we build administrator training and documentation into every project so teams can run their systems independently after go-live. We are a remote-first team of consultants who understand that a dashboard is only useful if the data is accurate to the cent and available the morning a period closes. Whether it is a cloud migration or a complex forecasting model, we value precision over presentation.

What You Will Do
Organize and clean large datasets from logistics operations to ensure they are ready for financial consolidation.
Assist consultants in verifying that intercompany eliminations are calculated correctly within the EPM software.
Run daily data validation checks to compare system outputs against source files and spreadsheets.
Help build and maintain basic reporting templates in Power BI to track key performance indicators for the client.
Document system configuration steps so that client administrators can understand how their data flows.
Support the testing phase of new system updates by identifying discrepancies in financial reports.
Collaborate with the team through digital channels to resolve data entry errors or mapping issues.

What We Are Looking For
A basic understanding of accounting or finance principles, such as balance sheets and profit and loss statements.
Strong familiarity with Microsoft Excel, including the use of formulas to organize data.
Technical curiosity and an interest in learning how enterprise software handles complex financial rules.
High attention to detail and a habit of double-checking work for accuracy.
The ability to work independently in a fully remote environment while staying in sync with a distributed team.
Clear communication skills to explain findings or issues discovered during data reviews.
Prior experience with data visualization tools or basic databases is helpful but not required for this level.

What We Offer
A permanent, full-time position with a fully remote work structure.
Practical experience working with enterprise-level tools like Oracle EPM, SAP, and Power BI.
Exposure to the inner workings of global logistics and finance operations.
Direct mentorship from senior consultants who value teaching and clear documentation.
A professional environment that prioritizes technical accuracy over corporate posturing.
Competitive pay that is attractive for an entry-level role in the current market.

How We Work

Our firm operates on the belief that consulting should provide clear, finished results. We use fixed-price contracts and well-defined scopes to ensure everyone knows what needs to be done. We do not use filler language or vague goals. Our team focuses on making sure that when we finish a project, the client has a system they can actually use and maintain. By working remotely, we stay efficient and focused on the technical requirements of the finance teams we serve. We expect every team member to value the precision of the numbers above all else.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets.

Who We Are

Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI) has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. We’re team players and safety fanatics. And we're proud to be part of Quanta Services (PWR:NYSE), North America's largest employer of skilled craft labor. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.

THE PURCHASING TEAM

The purchasing team manages all equipment and materials purchases for both job sites and corporate expenditures. This includes vetting vendors and establishing and maintaining relationships with new and loyal suppliers

About The Role

The Procurement Data Analyst is responsible for maintaining the accuracy, integrity, and effectiveness of procurement and asset-related data to support operational efficiency and informed business decisions. This role serves as a key steward of procurement master data, including item master records, equipment and fleet data, vendor pricing, and procurement system information. The position analyzes data trends, develops reports and dashboards, supports vendor pricing and point-of-sale data management, and collaborates with cross-functional teams to improve processes, enhance system capabilities, and support automation initiatives. Working with general direction, the Procurement Data Analyst independently manages assigned data domains, investigates issues, recommends solutions, and collaborates with stakeholders to implement improvements.

jobs.title: Junior Research Analyst
jobs.description:
Braun Management addresses structural friction within executive teams to resolve organizational problems that have become too internal to fix. We provide rigorous analysis and evidence-backed conclusions to help leadership teams navigate complex governance and clarify decision rights.

The role

As a Junior Research Analyst, you will support our consulting team by gathering and organizing the data necessary for high-stakes executive engagements. Our partner is a Mediterranean technology firm, and much of your work will focus on assisting them with structural adjustments and market entry challenges. This role exists to ensure that our recommendations are grounded in accurate, verified information rather than intuition or generic advice. Because we operate as a fully remote team, your ability to conduct independent research and document your findings clearly is essential.

What you will do
Conducting background research on industry trends and specific company structures to identify points of organizational friction.
Compiling data reports that help our consultants understand how decision rights are currently distributed within client organizations.
Assisting in the preparation of written documentation that outlines evidence-backed paths forward for executive leadership.
Reviewing regulatory environments and governance requirements that impact our partner firm operations.
Organizing internal databases to ensure that qualitative interviews and quantitative data are easily accessible to the team.
Drafting summaries of complex business systems to help clarify where internal accountability has broken down.
Monitoring news and updates related to our specific client engagements to keep the team informed of external shifts.
Supporting the senior consultants in verifying historical performance data and organizational charts.

What we are looking for
A strong interest in understanding how complex business systems and corporate governance function in practice.
The ability to write clearly and concisely without relying on filler or corporate jargon.
High attention to detail when cross-referencing data points and verifying the accuracy of research materials.
Familiarity with basic research methodologies, perhaps gained through university projects or recent internships.
Comfort working in a remote environment where communication relies heavily on written updates and documentation.
A logical approach to problem-solving and a preference for evidence over speculation.
Willingness to learn about European governance structures and the specific challenges of organizational restructuring.
Professionalism and the ability to handle sensitive corporate information with discretion.

How we work

Braun Management operates entirely without physical offices, valuing the focus and precision that a remote setting allows. Our culture is built on written clarity and rigorous thinking, meaning we spend less time in meetings and more time producing high-quality analysis. We believe that accountability is better served by clear documentation than by constant verbal check-ins. Every team member is expected to contribute to a culture of honesty, where we address difficult structural truths directly to help our clients move forward. This remote structure requires self-discipline and a commitment to maintaining high standards of work without direct, in-person supervision.

What we offer
A permanent, full-time position that is 100 percent remote.
Competitive pay that is attractive for an entry-level role in the consulting and research sector.
Exposure to high-level organizational challenges and executive decision-making processes.
A work environment that prioritizes clear communication and evidence-backed results over office politics.
Paid time off and flexible scheduling within a results-oriented framework.
The opportunity to work with a Mediterranean technology firm on its expansion and structural growth.

In this role, your research will become the foundation for the difficult conversations our consultants have with executive leadership. By uncovering the structural truths that hinder growth, you help provide the clarity needed for organizations to reform their decision rights. Your work directly contributes to providing a clear, written path forward for the firms we serve.

While primarily focused on the Revenue Intelligence development lifecycle, this position will also support go-to-market (GTM) initiatives, service lifecycle efforts, organizational communications, and other strategic programs as business priorities evolve.

Reviewing Project documents for clarity and completeness - examples include scope documents, project plan, contracts, equipment and construction bid packages, requisitions, Bills of Material or Material Requests for Issue, Task Authorizations, and Engineering Work Requests.
Reviewing Project and contract budgets for adequacy and completeness. Initiating and ensuring budget revisions made and documented when required.
Ensuring change management protocols are followed to ensure complete documentation for changes in scope, schedule and costs.
Providing project status reports. Recurring, standard reports and ad hoc reports that address status of scope, budget and schedule and that identifies risks and issues and outlines mitigation strategy.
Obtaining concurrence (or buy-in) from affected departments to support the proposed schedule and resource requirements. Review and approval of Project Plans.
Validating project estimates including contingency.
Developing, with input of project team, the strategic and tactical execution plan for the project.
Monitoring and / or reporting contractor resource levels.

Responsible for the quality assurance and control program, including identification of quality requirements, responsibility for QA program (Energy Delivery's or Contractor's program) and if required, review and approval process for contractor provided procedures.
Communicating Project goals, priorities and decisions to the Region/Corporate Leadership Team.
Ensuring Project challenge meetings, peer reviews and assessments are performed.
Working with Project Controls to develop and update the Project schedule.
Identifying and notifying the Project Team of additional resources or requirements necessary to meet the Project scope or schedule
Ensuring the close-out and lessons-learned protocols are completed. Participating in audit of completed projects to evaluate whether identified objectives and benefits have been realized.

Responsibilities

An employee hired at the Transmission Project Manager IV level will be expected to perform all of the above responsibilities with more proficiency, and in a more independent manner. Further, the Transmission Project Manager IV level employee will be assigned additional responsibilities related to those above, including:

The level IV employee will be assigned projects of increasing complexity. At this level the Project Manager is expected to manage any project in the portfolio with guidance as needed from the Manager. Projects assigned will progress in complexity and variety to facilitate acquiring a breadth of knowledge and experience to become and subject matter expert and progress to next level.

Bachelor of Science degree in Business, Engineering, Finance, Construction Management or related field is required. Minimum of 3 years’ related experience required. In lieu of degree, consideration will be given to applicants having 7 years related experience or 5 years transmission experience.

Bachelor of Science degree in Business, Engineering, Finance, Construction Management or related field is required. Minimum of 5 years’ related experience required. In lieu of degree, consideration will be given to applicants having 10 years related experience or 7 years transmission experience.
Related experience includes project organization, engineering, finance, construction, project management, planning or project controls.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT M'RHEN

M'RHEN is a New York–and Taipei–based luxury womenswear brand focused on refined femininity, emotional resonance, and intentional craftsmanship. Produced in New York City, the brand is known for its elevated tailoring, feminine silhouettes, and intimate approach to luxury.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a sharp, highly organized, and resourceful Executive & Business Operations Manager
to work directly alongside our Founder & Creative Director and serve as an operational right hand across M'RHEN.
This is a highly hands-on role at the center of a growing luxury fashion company. You will own key day-to-day business operations while providing the executive support that enables the founder and broader team to operate effectively. Your scope will span business and financial administration, executive operations, inventory and ecommerce, showroom and client experience, and special projects.
We are looking for someone who doesn't simply execute tasks, but creates structure, identifies what needs attention, follows through across multiple stakeholders, and takes ownership of getting things done.
Because M'RHEN is a small and growing company, there is no hierarchy of tasks. You should be equally comfortable preparing financial reports, coordinating with an accountant or production partner, managing a VIP client request, organizing the founder's international travel, or preparing the showroom ahead of an appointment.
For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to become a trusted operating partner to the founder while gaining firsthand exposure to the commercial, financial, creative, and operational decisions involved in building a luxury fashion house.

BUSINESS & FINANCIAL OPERATIONS

Maintain day-to-day financial visibility across the business, including expense tracking, receipt management, accounts payable and receivable, reconciliations, and cash-flow reporting.
Coordinate vendor payments, client invoicing, and payment follow-up.
Maintain organized financial records and liaise with the brand's external accountant on bookkeeping, tax preparation, reporting, and related financial administration.
Work with production and the founder to maintain visibility into production costs, margins, inventory value, and collection-level spending.
Prepare financial and operational information to support the founder's budgeting, cash-planning, and collection-planning decisions.
Coordinate payroll, insurance, business filings, and basic HR and compliance administration.
Build and maintain operational systems for expenses, inventory, reporting, documentation, and internal communication.
Identify operational gaps and proactively implement better processes as the company grows.

EXECUTIVE & FOUNDER OPERATIONS

Manage the founder's calendar, appointments, meetings, and daily priorities, anticipating needs and protecting the founder's time.
Coordinate domestic and international travel, itineraries, reservations, and transportation with precision.
Handle personal errands and administrative needs with discretion and follow-through.
Maintain organization across documents, contracts, receipts, records, and internal systems.
Liaise with factories, freelancers, PR teams, stylists, consultants, and external partners on behalf of the founder.
Track key follow-ups, deadlines, and outstanding decisions across the business, ensuring priorities move forward.
Prepare materials, information, and briefings needed for meetings and decision-making.
Support day-to-day operational needs and special priorities as they arise.

INVENTORY & ECOMMERCE OPERATIONS

Oversee accurate and timely fulfillment of ecommerce and client orders.
Maintain visibility into studio inventory, garment movements, and stock levels.
Maintain accurate inventory records and flag discrepancies or low-stock positions.
Coordinate sample trafficking, messenger pickups, shipments, returns, and inventory transfers.
Coordinate with studio and production partners to ensure garments and samples are where they need to be.
Support Shopify and other ecommerce operations and workflows as needed.

SHOWROOM & CLIENT EXPERIENCE

Manage and service showroom appointments with warmth, professionalism, discretion, and a strong eye for styling.
Serve as a first point of contact for VIP clients and custom-order inquiries, gathering details, communicating timelines, and escalating decisions to the founder when appropriate.
Communicate with clients via email and phone with exceptional care and precision.
Support gifting, hospitality, alterations, special orders, and order coordination to maintain an elevated client experience.
Maintain showroom presentation, including merchandising, steaming, organization, and restocking.
Support trunk shows, pop-ups, photoshoots, market appointments, and other brand events.

SPECIAL PROJECTS

As a close operating partner to the founder, the Executive & Business Operations Manager will support projects that fall outside a traditional job description. These may include research, vendor sourcing, events, new operational systems, market preparation, client initiatives, and other priorities that arise as the company grows.
The ability to take an ambiguous problem, determine what needs to happen, and drive it toward completion is essential.

QUALIFICATIONS

2–4 years of relevant professional experience; experience in fashion, luxury, retail, hospitality, or another highly detail-oriented environment strongly preferred.
Prior experience supporting a founder, entrepreneur, executive, or creative leader is a strong plus.
Strong operational instincts and demonstrated ability to create structure, maintain systems, and follow projects through to completion.
Comfortable working with numbers and financial information, with a working knowledge of bookkeeping, AP/AR, reconciliations, and basic financial reporting.
Experience with QuickBooks or similar accounting software is a plus.
Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
High level of discretion, judgment, and professionalism; comfortable handling sensitive business, financial, client, and personal information.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong client-facing presence and comfort interacting with high-end clientele and senior external partners.
A critical eye for garments, presentation, fit, and styling.
Proactive, resourceful, and calm under pressure, with the instinct to identify what needs to happen rather than waiting to be assigned every task.
Comfortable moving fluidly between high-level and hands-on responsibilities.
Familiarity with Shopify, Google Workspace, Notion, Airtable, or similar platforms is a plus.
Based in New York City with flexibility for occasional evenings and weekends during events, shoots, and market periods.

WHO WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE

You may be a particularly strong fit if you naturally notice what is missing, create a system for it, and follow through without needing repeated direction.
You are interested not only in fashion, but in how a fashion business actually works
. You want exposure to the decisions behind product, clients, operations, finance, production, PR, and growth—and you are willing to do the detailed work required to understand them.
You are comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial environment where priorities can shift quickly and no two days look exactly the same. You enjoy being close to the action, operating with a high level of trust, and becoming increasingly valuable as you develop a deeper understanding of the founder and the business.

EXECUTIVE & FOUNDER OPERATIONS

Please send a brief introduction and your resume to info@m-rhen.com
with the subject line “Executive & Business Operations Manager — M'RHEN.”

In your introduction, please tell us briefly why you are interested in working inside an emerging luxury fashion company and share one example of a time you took ownership of a problem without being told exactly how to solve it.
We review applications on a rolling basis and will be in touch with candidates whose experience aligns closely with the role.

jobs.description:
Join our Insights and Analytics team at Helen of Troy and make an immediate impact on our trusted brands: OXO, Hydro Flask, Osprey, Honeywell, PUR, Braun, Vicks, Hot Tools, Drybar, Curlsmith, Revlon, and Olive & June. Together, we build innovative and useful products that elevate people's lives everywhere, every day.

Look around your home, and you'll find us everywhere,
in your kitchen, living room, bedroom, and bathroom. We are already making your everyday lives better. We are powered by knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and forward-thinking people committed to developing a culture of inclusion. Whether you are just starting your career or in need of a challenge, we recognize, develop, and empower talent!

Position:
Media Operations Analyst

Department:
Analytics for all brands

Work Location:
Morristown, NJ Hybrid (work 3 days onsite)

Hybrid Schedule:
At Helen of Troy, we embrace a flexible hybrid work model designed to support collaboration and productivity. For roles eligible for hybrid work, our standard schedule includes in-office collaboration from Tuesday through Thursday, with the option to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays. Any updates to this model will be communicated in advance. Please note that hybrid eligibility and schedules may vary based on business needs and manager expectations.

What You Will Be Doing

The Analyst, Media Operations role will sit on the Insights and Analytics team. This position will support the development, governance, and quality assurance of media data operations across Helen of Troy’s portfolio. This role will help ensure that paid media tracking, taxonomy, tagging, and reporting inputs are accurate, consistent, and usable downstream.

Media Operations sit at the intersection of media, analytics, agency operations, and DTC/IT data enablement. The Media Ops Analyst will partner closely with internal Analytics, Media, DTC, Brand, Demand Planning, IT, and agency teams to enforce standards, identify data quality gaps, and reduce downstream rework caused by inconsistent tracking or fragmented operational ownership.

Support day-to-day media operations governance across paid media campaigns, ensuring campaign setup, naming conventions, UTM parameters, taxonomy, and tracking requirements are consistently applied across channels, platforms, brands, and agency partners.
Monitor campaign data feeds and dashboard inputs to identify missing, misclassified, or inconsistent data across platforms such as Adobe, GA4, and other relevant environments.
Own recurring QA processes to validate that media tracking and tagging are sit on the functioning end-to-end, from campaign launch through reporting ingestion, dashboarding, and analytics use cases.
Support end-to-end site tracking and PLP implementation.
Support cross-functional alignment on media performance inputs, including flowcharts, campaign change logs, KPI benchmarks, site analytics, and other data sources used to connect media investment to business results.
Maintain and enforce media taxonomy standards, UTM governance, campaign naming conventions, and related documentation to support scalable and consistent performance reporting.
Support the implementation of data quality controls, issue logs, and escalation processes to reduce manual workarounds, reporting ambiguity, and recurring data cleanup.

Skills Needed To Be Successful In This Role

Experience with Adobe Analytics or other site analytics or e-commerce tool.
Understanding of e-commerce, paid media operations, campaign trafficking, tracking implementation, taxonomy, UTM structure, and reporting workflows.
Comfort working with digital media platforms, web analytics, dashboarding tools, and campaign data sets.
Strong project management and documentation skills, with the ability to build repeatable processes, governance standards, and operational playbooks.
Detail oriented and analytical mindset.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
1+ years of experience in media operations, marketing operations, digital analytics, campaign operations, data operations, or a related function.
Working knowledge of UTM governance, campaign taxonomy, pixel/tag validation, QA processes, data ingestion, and dashboard reporting.
Authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with Adobe Analytics or similar tools.

In New Jersey, the standard base pay range for this role is $70,447 - $88,059 annually. This base pay range is specific to New Jersey and may not be applicable to other locations. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to location, experience, skill level, and performance. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees.

Benefits:
Salary + Bonus ,
Healthcare, Dental, Vision, Paid Holidays, Paid Parental Leave, 401(k) with company match, Basic Life Insurance, Short Term Disability (STD), Long Term Disability (LTD), Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Charitable (volunteer) Leave, and Educational Assistance.

Who We Are

Provenir is the unified Decision Intelligence Platform that gives enterprises full control over end- to-end customer decisioning — to manage risk, drive growth, and transform business outcomes. By consolidating data, AI models, intelligence, agents and governance into a single decisioning environment, Provenir empowers business teams to configure and evolve strategy directly, while maintaining enterprise-grade reliability and regulatory compliance. Trusted by 120+ institutions in 60+ countries, Provenir processes over 4 billion decisions annually — turning architectural coherence into sustained risk performance and measurable value. Ready to solve meaningful challenges, work with enterprise customers, and help shape the future of AI-powered decisioning? Join us.

What You’ll Do

This is not a back-seat Program Manager role. As a Senior Program Manager
, you’ll lead high-complexity, high-visibility software implementations for our largest and most strategic clients — including tier-one banks and major financial institutions
. You’ll own end-to-end delivery across multiple concurrent programs, be the trusted escalation point for executive stakeholders, and formally mentor Project Managers and Consultants across our Global Applied Intelligence team.

You’ll also help shape how we deliver — scoping new project phases, sharpening our delivery methodology, and leaving every engagement (and every teammate) better than you found them.

What You’ll Own

Lead flagship engagements — run one or more senior client engagements simultaneously, including complex, multi-workstream implementations for tier-one banks and financial institutions.
Deliver, predictably — own consistent, successful delivery, ensuring scope, requirements, staffing, and budget are well defined at every stage of the project lifecycle.
Be the trusted advisor — act as the primary escalation point for executive and C-level client stakeholders, managing expectations and building durable relationships.
Orchestrate global teams — manage resources across internal teams, clients, and third-party vendors, including cross-regional and cross-functional teams.
Keep the record straight — create and maintain documentation for key decisions, action items, issues, and risks.
Shape the solution — document detailed requirements for enhancements and new features, partnering with Architects and Consultants on solution design.
Drive quality — organize and lead user acceptance testing (UAT) with the right stakeholders.
Manage risk like a pro — identify and manage project risk, including regulatory and compliance considerations specific to banking and financial services.
Communicate relentlessly — proactively report project and program status to internal and external stakeholders at every level, including senior leadership, and resolve functional and technical questions as they arise.
Grow the team — mentor and coach Project Managers and Consultants, supporting their development and performance.
Grow the business — ensure client satisfaction, and identify and progress future opportunities.
Own the commercials — lead the creation, accuracy, and lifecycle of Statements of Work (SOWs) — scoping, effort/cost estimation, change orders, and renewals — in partnership with Sales, Delivery leadership, and Legal.

Qualifications, Strengths, And Skills

Experience —
8+ years in Project Management, with a demonstrated track record delivering large-scale, complex software implementations for tier-one banks or other major financial institutions.

Education —

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, AUTA, Amazon University Reimagined
jobs.description:
Description

Are you passionate about orchestrating complex, cross-functional initiatives that transform how Amazon operates globally? The Amazon University Talent Acquisition (AUTA) team is seeking a Program Manager III to lead transformative tech initiatives that unite process, program, and technology needs across Amazon's global talent acquisition ecosystem.

In this unique role you'll serve as the strategic bridge between AUTA's business needs and technical solution delivery, ensuring that technology enables our ideal state processes and programs rather than constraining them. Your focus will be on defining and delivering business requirements to our tech teams, ensuring technical teams deliver a solution that meets our business customers', stakeholders', and internal teams' needs and high standards.

Key job responsibilities

Refine (or redefine) and champion the ideal-state vision for AUTA top of funnel (attractin, sourcing, and screening) as well as interview scheduling, working across technical, program, and recruiting teams to align on a shared direction that serves business customers, candidates, and recruiters
Lead end-to-end program management of complex cross-functional initiatives with considerable impact, establishing clear success criteria, employing workback plans and mechanisms to keep this project on track, and driving resolution of blockers across multiple stakeholder groups
Communicate clear prioritization of AUTA's most pressing problems/needs and ensuring tech teams design solutions meet diverse user persona needs
Create and maintain comprehensive project information, driving crisp decisions and clear communication of progress, timelines, and escalations to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
Define, monitor, and analyze key performance metrics to identify optimization opportunities, proactively mitigate risks before they become roadblocks, and ensure solutions improve operational efficiency across the global recruitment lifecycle

A day in the life

You'll partner closely with AUTA teams and customers to understand their unique use cases and challenges, then collaborate with technical teams to ensure solutions align with operational and business needs. Your day involves maintaining a deep knowledge of AUTA's current and ideal-state operating model for demand, making sure that AUTA delivers quality and on-time information to technical teams, partnering with tech on a comprehensive workback schedules, driving intake and prioritization discussions across competing initiatives, analyzing performance metrics to identify opportunities, and coordinating launch readiness and change management planning to support successful rollouts across multiple teams and personas.

About The Team

AURA works within AUTA, Amazon's central campus hiring organization who support recruiting efforts across all streams, most countries, and over 150 roles. The team partners with AUTA to define ideal state processes and programs, then collaborates with technical teams to ensure solutions meet those needs effectively.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years of driving process improvements experience
Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
Knowledge of general AI tools
Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

jobs.description:
Position Description

CGI Federal is currently seeking an experienced Robotic Process Automation (RPA) Analyst to support a large Department of Homeland Security program.

This role will primarily focus on front end RPA/automation analysis, including conducting discovery sessions with DHS customers, mapping processes, identifying automation candidates, assessing feasibility, and translating operational challenges into clear requirements. The role partners with an existing RPA developer who handles build and deployment.

You will help determine whether something should be automated — not necessarily build the automation yourself.

This position is located in one of CGI Federal's offices in Fairfax, VA, Lebanon, VA, Lafayette, LA or Knoxville, TN; however, a hybrid working model is acceptable. You will be required to work in a CGI Federal office two days per week.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Conduct discovery sessions with DHS stakeholders to understand processes, pain points, and opportunities
Perform automation assessments including feasibility, complexity scoring, and value analysis
Document current state and future state workflows
Translate operational needs into clear, concise requirements
Work with the RPA developer to hand off validated, well defined automation candidates
Identify creative, innovative solutions to improve efficiency and reduce manual workloads
Support light testing and validation of automated solutions
Partner with business and technical teams to ensure accurate understanding of requirements

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Due to government contract and clearance requirements, U.S. citizenship and successful completion of a CGI background check are required.
3–5 years in business analysis, process analysis, or workflow optimization
Experience conducting discovery sessions and eliciting requirements from non technical stakeholders
Familiarity with RPA concepts (not necessarily deep development experience)
Experience evaluating processes for automation potential
Strong communication skills and comfort leading discussions with federal stakeholders
Ability to travel to client sites as needed.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Georgetown University comprises two unique campuses in the nation’s capital. With the Hilltop Campus located in the heart of the historic Georgetown neighborhood, and the Capitol Campus, just minutes from the U.S. Capitol and U.S. Supreme Court, Georgetown University offers rigorous academic programs, a global perspective, and unparalleled opportunities to engage with Washington, D.C. Our community is a close-knit group of remarkable individuals driven by intellectual inquiry, a commitment to social justice, and a shared dedication to making a difference in the world.

Requirements

Job Overview

The Office of Human Subject Protections (OHSP) is responsible for the review of all research activities that involve human subjects in accordance with federal regulations. The OHSP operations analyst will work under the direction of the Senior Director of the OHSP to manage the administrative functions necessary for the successful operations of the office. These functions include being the first point of contact for the OHSP offices, Email management, operational meeting agendas and minutes, administrative management of IRB membership, IRB account creation and trouble-shooting, paper and electronic file management, website development and management, carrying out financial functions (IRB charge back and tracking, expense approvals, supply ordering), coordination of the compilation of OHSP metrics for required reporting, general correspondence, create and publish public communication, and assist in managing office HR actions. Additionally assist in account management of HURON, CITI and others as needed.

Work Interactions

The Office of Human Subject Protections serves as the official oversight office for human subject research activities at Georgetown University. The Office of Human Subject Protections reports to the Medical Center Vice President (VP) for Research and the Vice Provost of Research for the Main Campus. The OHSP program coordinator reports directly to the Senior Director of the OHSP. They will serve to assist both the Office of Research Quality Assurance and the Institutional Review Board that fall under the OHSP. The position will interact with the research community as the first point of contact for the office and will assist in creating and publishing any public facing materials and communication. As such, this position requires someone with collaborative and concise verbal and written communication skills. The program coordinator will engage directly with the staff in OHSP on a daily basis to triage incoming communication. The individual in the position will be a critical member of the OHSP to ensure efficient operations.

Requirements And Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and 2-3 years of experience in operational management skills
Experience demonstrating highly effective communications skills and ability to work on multiple projects.
Computer proficiency is required, including MS Word, Excel, internet browsers, and email.
Basic financial management skills
Experience using video meeting and scheduling platforms.

Preferred Requirements And Qualifications

Masters in health care management, business or certificate in project management
Previous experience in administrative position
Website management
Familiarity with IRB/research software platforms

Work Mode Designation

This position has been designated as Hybrid 1 Day. Please note that work mode designations are regularly reviewed in order to meet the evolving needs of the University. Such review may necessitate a change to a position’s mode of work designation. Contribute to bid reviews, project pursuits and mobilisation activities for major opportunities.
Promote collaboration across business groups, disciplines and geographic regions to maximise value for clients and the business.
Support the continuous development of project management standards, procedures, templates and lessons learned programmes.
Undertake project audits, governance reviews and quality assurance activities as required.
Ensure compliance with HDR Quality Management Systems, environmental management procedures and all applicable company policies.
Champion a culture of safety, integrity, accountability and continuous improvement.
Represent HDR professionally within industry forums, client organisations and professional institutions.
Perform other duties as required to support the successful operation and growth of the business.

Requirements

Degree qualified in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related discipline.
Minimum 10 years relevant industry experience, including significant experience delivering multidisciplinary engineering or consultancy projects.

The Commissioning Senior Project Manager is responsible for supporting all aspects of the project. This person will work as part of the project team and interact closely with the owners, designers, contractors, subcontractors and other trades on projects in mission critical environments.

The role includes developing and evaluating bid proposals, developing commissioning plans and schedules, facilitating communication and ensuring compliance with owner’s requirements, applicable laws and specifications.

The Commissioning Senior Project Manager will be self-directed on day-to-day work and independently performs most responsibilities. Will lead project teams of complex scope and broader programs. Will coordinate activities of other personnel. Assists in the development of policies and procedures.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Manage all Elements of Commissioning Projects (50%)

Manage pre-construction elements including project initiation, kickoff, RFIs and submittals
Coordinate resource and material forecasting
Develop, manage and monitor schedule
Participate in, schedule and lead project meetings
Coordinate / perform QA / QC and Cx plans and specifications to ensure completion in accordance with the project scope and appropriate guidelines and manuals
Communicate and coordinate project staffing needs
Oversee start-up, cutover, pre-functional or functional testing and project closeout
Onboard project team for mobilization
Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
Lead preparation of final commissioning report for submission to client
Develop testing plans and procedures for complex projects

Monitor and Control Project Financials (20%)

Prepare, forecast and monitor project budgets, profitability, margins, bill rates and utilization and maintain overall responsibility for the profitability of the project
Communicate with the client when additional fees / change orders are required
Identify potential project risks and develop / implement strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines

Manage Stakeholder Relations (25%)

Prepare proposals, presentations and the overall marketing efforts of the firm
Promote firm, service and expertise to existing or potential clients
Maintain client relationship to ensure an ongoing positive relationship and work with clients to identify and develop new projects
Support contact for clients and build effective, long-term client relationships
Ensure client satisfaction through active communication

Perform On-site Commissioning Activities (5%)

Perform on-site commissioning activities including inspection, testing, troubleshooting, and equipment validation for electrical and mechanical systems
Use technical testing equipment and coordinate vendors/contractors during execution
Ensure assigned tasks and deliverables are completed on time and within budget
Strong knowledge of commissioning, construction procedures, project management, and industry best practices
Skilled in resource allocation, personnel management, strategic planning, and team coordination
Experience with materials, methods, and tools used in mission critical and commercial construction projects
Detail-oriented with strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in both onsite and remote environments
Effective written and verbal communication skills, including direct client interaction and reporting
Capable of managing deadlines, delegating work, and handling multiple priorities simultaneously
Proficient in MS Office Suite and adaptable to client/industry-specific software
Committed to company and site safety requirements

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (ADVANCED LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED)

In-depth knowledge of electrical, mechanical and controls system principles
Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation
Ability to work successfully in a remote environment thru effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with minimal supervision
Ability to lead project teams of complex scope and coordinate the activities of other personnel
Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
Ability to achieve certification for NFPA70E and / or OSHA training as / if required
Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools.

On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

Lead project handover and close-out activities, ensuring all deliverables are completed, documented, and transitioned effectively to operational stakeholders.

Experience with Smartsheet or comparable project management platforms.

Proficiency with Google Workspace (or similar productivity tools) and the ability to quickly learn new systems and technologies.

Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage competing stakeholder interests, and drive projects to successful outcomes.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, with expertise in project reporting, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
What You’ll Be Doing

The Project Manager is a key position at Jensen Infrastructure. You’ll design and coordinate multiple product lines for precast concrete products. You’re the point person who determines proper process flow to ultimately manufacture quality products and fulfill on-time deliveries.

Reporting to our Sales Manager, you’ll communicate with our production department regarding schedule requirements, with our customers, outside sales, and engineers regarding project contract, with our delivery and yard departments for safe and on-time delivery, and report progress and challenges to the leadership team.

A Highlight Of Your Day-to-day Will Include

Managing and coordinating all aspects of large and/or custom projects.
Managing the work order process to provide accurate work orders and drawings for production.
Producing an accurate bill of materials (BOM) for precast concrete structures being planned for production. Inputting BOMs into the manufacturing software to reflect an accurate accounting of the cost associated with each product being manufactured on a job-by-job basis.
Managing project take-offs and estimating for projects in the planning and bidding stages.
Tracking and reporting project progress from submittal stage to product installation via our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.
Ensuring deliverables fall within the applicable scope, schedule, and budget.
Preparing a weekly sales report for the Sales Manager’s review and distribution to the team.
Ensuring that mutually agreed upon contract clearly specifies terms and conditions and all products requested clearly specify requirements per drawings and plans so that the estimates are 100% accurate for each project in support of efficiency, accuracy, and deadline adherence.
Communicating the date the product can be manufactured and ready for delivery, changes to orders, add-ons, and any other issues that may arise during the manufacturing process to the customers.
Ensuring delivery date is scheduled per customer needs and delivered as requested.
Obtaining project site specifications and safety standards to communicate with dispatch for offloading products, and understanding hazards for crane operators.
Participating in entertainment functions with customers (e.g., lunches, dinners).
Participating in tradeshows, seminars, and classes to improve product knowledge and/or personal skills.

Who We Are Looking For

You’re enthusiastic and motivated in a fast-paced environment. You possess demonstrated project management experience, preferably in a precast concrete or building materials environment (minimum of 3 years). You’re a lifelong learner preferably with a bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or construction management. Your passion for customers comes first and you aren’t bothered by having to manage the details in the CRM. You don’t take shortcuts. You’re safety conscious not just for yourself, but for your team.

We’re open to individuals who aren’t just looking for their next job, they’re looking to build a career. You want an opportunity to showcase your skillset in dispatch/logistics, strategic planning and business development with a solid company who will invest in you. In our culture – everyone matters.

All About Jensen Infrastructure

Much like you, our founder, Don Jensen was looking for a way to support his family, so he started his Company in 1968. Since founded, we’ve been supporting communities across Nevada, California, Arizona, Washington, Missouri, and Hawaii.

Jensen Infrastructure likely has an impact on your daily life. We build culverts to take water away from your neighborhoods, underground utility boxes to hold cables, and manholes to allow workers access to the sewers deep below the roads we drive on. And that’s just a small sample of what we do at Jensen on a daily basis.

When you work at one of Jensen’s many locations, you will enjoy the close relationships and camaraderie of a small company while being part of a larger, well-established, growing company.

We are committed to ensuring employment practices that promote equal opportunities. Please let us know if you require any reasonable accommodations during your interview process.

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

What We Are Looking For

Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are ready to help build a transportation ecosystem that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient and accessible for all.

We're searching for a Staff Technical Program Manager to support our Electrical Distribution Systems (EDS) and Vehicle Integration Teams (VIT). As our hardware roadmap has grown in scale and complexity, we need a TPM to serve as the "connective tissue" between electrical design and physical implementation — spanning the full product lifecycle and engaging across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing and operations. This is a high-impact role where you'll drive cross-functional execution on some of Aurora's most critical programs. The role sits within the Hardware Product Engineering (HPE) organization and reports through VIT TPM leadership.

In this role you will

EDS Leadership: Engage with HPE and cross-functional development teams to ensure EDS work is reflected in program schedules and that all prerequisite materials are delivered on time.
Cross-Functional Integration: Engage with HPE and cross-functional development teams to ensure EDS is represented, accounted for in program planning, and that all prerequisite materials are delivered on time.
First Article Development: Act as the primary liaison for internal “first article” harness builds and help advise on build priorities across the portfolio. Solicit redline feedback and ensure it’s incorporated into designs.
External Fabrication Support: Partner with supply chain, quality, and our external suppliers to align on design releases, build plans, identify material bottlenecks, and establish implementation schedules.
Risk Management: Guide the engineering team through planning and execution of EDS risk assessments to proactively identify and mitigate program risks.
Design Control: Lead EDS focused engineering change control board (CCB) submissions from initiation through incorporation and support the documentation/activities associated with final safety case closure.
Operational Excellence: Look for opportunities to standardize and streamline team processes and ways of working. For example, standardizing how the team tracks work through the development lifecycle.

Required Qualifications

5 Years + experience managing complex hardware development programs leveraging cross-functional resources in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and quality
Proven ability to build and maintain program control documentation including integrated master schedules, risk registers, resource plans, and budgets
Experience executing engineering change management processes
Proficiency with program and task management tools such as Smartsheet, MS Project, Jira, and Confluence.
Ability to be located in Pittsburgh, PA.
Ability to travel, up to 20%

Desirable Qualifications

Deep familiarity with electrical distribution systems, harness architecture, and the associated design and release process.
Experience leading programs and system development within the automotive or similar safety critical industries
Experience with electrical verification and reliability testing
Experience leading organizational change and/or implementing process improvement initiatives
Certified in project or program management (PMP, PgMP) or equivalent

The base salary range for this position is $163,000 - $236,000 per year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits.

Working at Aurora

At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks.

We believe in-person work increases collaboration, empathy and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, we operate in a hybrid work environment where Aurorans are in office at least 3 days per week.

Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom.

At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best-in-class self-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what.

new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities

About the team
Our team plays a crucial role in ensuring the company’s success. We seek people who are willing to learn and put in the effort to solve problems. Our challenges are not your regular day-to-day problems - you’ll be part of a team that’s developing new solutions to new challenges. It’s working fast, at scale, and we’re making a difference. We are looking for talents to join us on this exciting journey!

Responsibilities
We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our Tech and Product PMO team based in San Jose. You'll drive the end-to-end tasks that keep the systems behind TikTok running and work with various team members to deliver best user experiences and highest-standard user privacy. As a TPM, you’ll be the bridge between various teams and drive collaboration tasks across teams.
- Work closely with global cross-functional teams from Product, Engineering, and Sales in the US and mandarin-speaking countries to drive the end-to-end delivery of new products, services, and/or features to market.
- Manage a variety of complex, cross-functional programs and lead all aspects of assigned programs delivery.
- Create and maintain the Roadmap for the teams by working with the respective Tech and Product leaders.
- Define the way of driving the programs and constantly find ways to improve the process in a data-driven manner.
- Prepare the project schedule, define the milestones, and be the owner of the collaboration process and tools.
- Track and report progress, identify and mitigate risks, and remove blockers.
- Ensure products and applications release to market smoothly.
- Mentor and help develop the team.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Must have a technical educational background, such as a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
- 3 years of relevant work experience in project/program management or software development leadership.
- Must have at least 1 year of experience in each of the following: Leading Agile development processes, managing software development projects, including building development processes and coordinating release schedules, or creating and maintaining software development roadmaps for engineering teams.
- Managing stakeholder relationships and gathering feedback to build programs that support customer revenue, growth, and retention.
- Planning and executing projects using both Agile and Waterfall methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications
- Excellent cross-functional communication and collaboration skills.
- Experience operating in fast-paced environments and managing multiple priorities across time zones.
- Passion for problem-solving, process optimization, and delivering results in a data-driven and iterative way.
- Growth mindset with a willingness to take initiative and adapt in a constantly evolving environment.

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

MatX is on a mission to be the compute platform for AGI. We are developing vertically integrated full-stack solutions from silicon to systems including hardware and software to train and run the largest ML workloads for AGI. MatX is seeking silicon micro-architects and design engineers to join our team as we create best-in-class silicon for high-performance and sustainable GenAI. Successful candidates for these roles will be responsible for delivering performant and functionally accurate silicon for MatX products across compute, memory management. High-speed connectivity and other key technologies.

About The Role

MatX is building next-generation AI infrastructure systems for high-performance datacenter workloads. We are looking for a Senior NPI TPM, Rack-Scale AI Systems
to manage integrated execution for rack and board platforms, spanning engineering builds through the final production ramp.

In this capacity, you will serve as the primary interface for manufacturing execution with external CM/JDM partners. You will coordinate workstreams across material readiness, PLM/BOM/ECO control, factory test deployment, quality metrics, and high-volume ramp readiness for high-performance AI infrastructure.

What You'll Do Here

Direct the integrated NPI lifecycle for rack and board platforms, spanning engineering builds through the final volume production ramp.
Act as the primary technical interface for manufacturing execution with external CM/JDM partners to ensure factory readiness.
Manage master build schedules, configuration matrices, and unit allocation while leading formal build-readiness governance.
Coordinate cross-functional workstreams across PLM, BOM control, ECOs, material readiness, and shipment logistics.
Oversee integrated execution across PCBA, high-power modules, liquid-cooled trays, and complex rack-level systems.
Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to finalize DFX requirements, serviceability standards, and factory-flow optimization.
Partner with test teams to deploy diagnostics, power characterization, and data-capture infrastructure prior to build kick-off.
Define metrics and dashboards to track first-pass yield, quality gates, and corrective actions throughout the development cycle.
Engage with Supply Chain to mitigate risks associated with long-lead semiconductor components and material shortages.
Lead ECO tracking and revision effectiveness, serving as the central point for build-level change communication.
Prepare executive-level reporting that summarizes technical risks, material gaps, and high-volume ramp readiness.
Ensure critical learnings from validation phases are captured in playbooks to drive predictable production-readiness plans.

Who You Are

8+ years of technical program management, NPI program management, manufacturing operations, hardware operations, or engineering program management experience.
Experience driving complex hardware builds through EVT, DVT, PVT, production readiness, and ramp.
Experience working with CM, JDM, ODM, or rack-scale manufacturing partners on build planning, factory readiness, issue closure, and manufacturing execution.
Experience with BOMs, AVLs, ECOs, configuration management, DFM/DFA/DFT, PCBA manufacturing, final assembly, factory test, and quality systems.
Experience tracking manufacturing KPIs such as first-pass yield, defect pareto, rework rate, test pass rate, build cycle time, and quality escapes.
Ability to drive schedules, risk management, issue tracking, milestone governance, and executive-level communication.
Strong cross-functional leadership across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, test, and external partner teams.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize build risks, tradeoffs, decisions, and schedule impact.
Proficiency with program-management and engineering collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, MS Project, Google Workspace, or equivalent.

Bonus Points If You Have

Experience with AI infrastructure, GPU/accelerator systems, datacenter racks, networking systems, storage systems, or high-power server platforms.
Experience coordinating programs involving rack-scale integration, liquid-cooled systems, high-speed interconnects, factory diagnostics, or system-level validation.
Prior hands-on experience in hardware, manufacturing, test, quality, supply chain, or NPI operations is a plus.

Compensation

The US base salary for this full-time position is determined based on a variety of factors including role, experience, location, job related skills, and relevant education and training. Career length is only a guideline for compensation.

Early Career - $120,000 - $250,000 + equity
Mid Career - $175,000 - $362,500 + equity
Senior Career - $250,000 - $475,000 + equity

Health: Company-subsidized Medical (Kaiser or Anthem) for employees & dependents, Guardian Dental and Vision insurances for employee & dependents, and life insurance (employee only), plus HSA and FSA offerings via Lively. See attached benefits 1-pager and full benefits guide for more info on benefits.
