new_jobs.title: Junior Research Analyst
new_jobs.description:
We are adding a Junior Research Analyst to our team to support a large scale engagement with a major financial services provider. This role is essential for keeping our advisory work grounded in facts and clear records. As a fully remote position, you will work alongside our consultants to help translate complex management discussions into simple, actionable information that a leadership team can use every day.

About the role

The Junior Research Analyst exists to help our advisory practice stay organized and focused. In many large organizations, information gets lost in long email chains or forgotten after a meeting ends. You will help prevent this by acting as the project memory. Your work ensures that when we give advice to a client, it is based on a solid understanding of how their teams actually operate.
This is an entry level role where you will learn to look at the structural habits of a business. You will spend your time gathering data, observing how decisions are made, and turning those observations into clear written notes. The goal is not to produce hundreds of pages of analysis, but to find the few specific details that explain why a project is stalling or why a team feels stuck. You will be helping us make management easier for our clients by providing them with a quiet, reliable record of their own progress.

What you will do
Participate in remote calls and interviews to capture decisions, open questions, and specific handoffs between teams.
Turn raw notes and recordings into concise summaries that highlight the most important themes.
Review internal client documents to map out how information currently flows from one department to another.
Help maintain a centralized project record so that every team member knows what was decided and who owns the next step.
Conduct basic research into management structures and meeting rhythms to provide context for our recommendations.
Assist in the preparation of briefing materials that help our consultants stay informed before client sessions.
Identify recurring issues in client data, such as meeting overlaps or unclear reporting lines, and summarize them clearly.
Update project trackers and documentation regularly to ensure all information is current and accurate.

What we are looking for
A direct and plain writing style. You should be able to explain a complex situation without using corporate jargon or fluff.
Excellent attention to detail. You notice when a small detail in a meeting contradicts an earlier decision.
Strong organizational habits. You enjoy creating order out of messy information and keeping documents tidy.
A calm and steady approach to tasks. You can focus on quiet work and take the time needed to get a summary right.
Willingness to learn. You are curious about how businesses work and how people collaborate in a professional setting.
Reliability in a remote setting. You are comfortable managing your own schedule and meeting deadlines without being chased.
A preference for clarity. You would rather ask a clarifying question than guess at what a client meant.

Helpful background
Basic familiarity with document editors and spreadsheet tools for organizing lists and notes.
Previous experience in an internship or a part time role that required careful record keeping or reporting.
Educational background in business, social sciences, communications, or a related field where writing was a primary focus.
Experience summarizing long texts or discussions into brief, understandable points.
Comfort using remote communication tools to stay in touch with a distributed team throughout the day.

What we offer

This is a permanent, full time position that is conducted entirely remotely. We offer a competitive salary that is attractive for an entry level research role and reflects the value you bring to our team. You will have the opportunity to learn a practical, no nonsense approach to consulting that focuses on helping people work better together. We value quiet focus, clear writing, and a healthy work life balance that respects your time outside of work hours.

About Olive Tree Consulting

Olive Tree Consulting Group is a focused advisory practice that helps leadership teams solve recurring management issues. We typically work on the space between strategy and daily execution. A team can have very capable people and still find that decisions keep reopening, priorities stall, or responsibility remains unclear. These are rarely personality problems; they are structural habits that have not kept up with the company growth.
We favor practical changes over large scale transformation programs. Our work involves looking at how decisions are made, how meetings are run, and how ownership is recorded. We prefer useful written notes and clear ownership over polished presentations and vague alignment. Good advisory work should make things plainer and leave the team with a rhythm they can continue on their own.
The firm is built on the principle that memory is not a management system. We help teams create the smallest possible written record to support their work so that important follow up does not depend on who was in the room or who has the best memory. The goal is a quieter management pattern that makes the existing work easier to lead.

Experience owning or supporting program priorities, measures, and operational health for content or risk domains.

Experience translating policy or legal requirements into practical workflows, controls, and escalation paths.

Experience converting operational signals into product, process, or policy changes.

Experience improving operating standards, documentation, and controls in a live program environment.
Background in high-scale consumer platforms, marketplaces, or technology products.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Do you want to be part of a global team that relentlessly pursues procurement excellence, improves operational processes and outcomes, and manages compliance and business risks? Do you have a solid procurement background, excel at program and stakeholder management, and thrive in a fast-paced environment?

We are hiring a Program Manager - Procurement Excellence to work closely with procurement stakeholders, operations, functions, systems and engineering to enable scalable, well-controlled business processes and decision-making.

This role sits within a broader team of program managers that operates as highly embedded business partners to procurement, focused on operational effectiveness and impact, scalable mechanisms, and risk-informed execution.

The ideal candidate combines strong business process thinking, stakeholder influence, operational rigor, and technical literacy to help teams move quickly while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.

The ideal candidate require a high tolerance of ambiguity aligned to AWS Day 1 culture, ability to influence executive decisions, drive strategic initiatives and change management that deliver meaningful programmatic improvements.

This is not a traditional audit or policy-focused role. We designed this role for individuals who enjoy solving operational problems, driving influence and alignment across teams, and building scalable mechanisms in fast-paced environments. Over time, this role has opportunity to evolve toward broader technical program management style leadership responsibilities.

Your Role

Business Partnership & Operational Enablement

Partner closely with Technical, Engineering, Operations, Procurement, and Risk stakeholders to shape scalable business processes and controls.
Engage early with teams to influence decisions, identify risks, and enable efficient execution.
Translate risk and controls requirements into practical, actionable operating mechanisms.

Risk & Controls Integration

Design and improve scalable controls, guardrails, and operational frameworks that support business velocity while managing risk appropriately.
Simplify and modernize existing processes to align with evolving business needs and risk appetite.
Ensure controls are operationally practical and embedded into day-to-day workflows.

Business Process & Mechanism Ownership

Identify process gaps, friction points, and operational inefficiencies across programs and workflows.
Build mechanisms, playbooks, decision frameworks, and scalable patterns that improve consistency and reduce ambiguity.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives across governance, operational readiness, and execution processes.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Audit Readiness

Act as a business partner to Procurement teams and a key coordination point across Risk, Audit, Assurance, Legal, Technical and Engineering teams.
Streamline audit readiness and evidence gathering through scalable operational processes rather than manual coordination.
Ensure teams have clarity on ownership, expectations, and escalation paths.

Technical & Operational Collaboration

Engage effectively with technical teams by understanding system architecture, workflows, dependencies, and operational trade-offs.
Partner with engineering teams to ensure controls and operational requirements are designed into solutions early.
Use data and operational signals to identify risks, trends, and improvement opportunities.

Procurement teams and functional partners proactively engage you as a trusted partner early in planning and execution.

Risk Management and controls are embedded into operational workflows rather than managed as separate activities.

new_jobs.title: HR Risk Operations Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The HR Risk Operations Project Manager is responsible for leading complex HR risk, compliance, and operational programs from strategy through execution. This role partners closely with People Experience, Legal, Compliance, HRIS, Payroll, Finance, and business stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements, policy priorities, and operational risks into practical programs, standard operating procedures, tools, controls, reporting, and stakeholder guidance. The Manager serves as a consultative resource on employment policy and HR compliance matters, providing clear recommendations, drafting policy-related materials, and supporting consistent, defensible decision-making across the organization.

This role requires strong project and program management discipline, including the ability to develop project plans, manage timelines, coordinate cross-functional workstreams, identify dependencies and risks, and drive deliverables to completion in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. The ideal candidate will bring strong data analytics capabilities, including experience analyzing workforce data, identifying trends and risk indicators, building dashboards or tracking tools, and translating data into executive-ready insights and recommendations.

The HR Risk Operations Project Manager serves as a key member of the People & Culture team in support of firm-wide goals and objectives. This role will report to the Associate Director of HR Risk Operations.

Key responsibilities:

HR Regulatory Program Management

Lead complex HR risk, compliance, and operational programs from planning through execution, including project plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
Translate legal, regulatory, and business requirements into scalable HR processes, controls, communications, training materials, and stakeholder guidance.
Coordinate cross-functional workstreams by aligning stakeholders, clarifying roles and responsibilities, documenting decisions, and ensuring timely follow-through.
Manage large-scale HR programs supporting multinational firms on the Grant Thornton platform, integrations, and business optimization initiatives.
Support firmwide compliance initiatives, including workforce analysis, Respect in the Workplace training, compliance questionnaires, and other high-priority or confidential projects in partnership with P&C and Legal.
Oversee the firmwide Affirmative Action program, including OFCCP audit response, vendor management, reporting, and program governance.

HR Risk Operations

Partner with Global HR teams to strengthen HR compliance controls and risk frameworks aligned with firm risk appetite.
Ensure HR risk monitoring frameworks remain effective, scalable, and responsive to regulatory changes and business needs.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, research summaries, and guidance materials related to HR risk operations and emerging trends.
Lead HR risk management priorities and develop practical short- and long-term solutions for complex business challenges.
Serve as an escalation point for client-related onboarding, background investigation matters, and contract review.
Collaborate with ICS functions, including Finance and Payroll, to improve operational consistency and advance risk management priorities.
Provide day-to-day work direction to global data analytics team members supporting HR risk operations.

Policy Governance

Own the development, implementation, maintenance, and governance of employment policies.
Serve as a policy consultation resource for People Experience, Legal, Compliance, HRIS, Payroll, Finance, and business stakeholders.
Provide practical guidance on employment policy interpretation, process application, and risk mitigation.
Partner with Legal and Compliance to align policies with global requirements and firm standards.
Drive policy harmonization across multinational firms, acquired entities, and evolving business models.
Draft employee-facing policy communications, FAQs, and intranet content to support consistent understanding and application.

Training & Operational Excellence

Monitor emerging labor and employment laws impacting firm policies; translate legal and business changes into practical process improvements and controls.
Develop and manage firmwide HR compliance training programs, including planning, stakeholder coordination, deployment, tracking, and continuous improvement.
Deliver internal training that addresses identified compliance risks, strengthens risk mitigation practices, and promotes a culture of compliance.
Support execution of the P&C strategic plan by advancing operational excellence initiatives aligned with industry standards and business priorities.
Recommend remediation actions, process improvements, and control enhancements based on audit results, monitoring findings, and identified risk trends.
Manage AI-related HR risks by applying firm governance, monitoring regulatory developments, and refining guidelines to support compliant and responsible use.

HR Workforce Analytics, Risk Strategy & Workforce Management

Develop and maintain dashboards, trackers, heat maps, and reporting tools to monitor HR risk, compliance activity, workforce trends, and program effectiveness.
Analyze workforce and operational data to identify trends, emerging risks, control gaps, and opportunities for automation or process improvement.
Prepare executive-ready summaries, insights, recommendations, and status updates to support leadership review and decision-making.
Partner with HRIS, Technology, and analytics teams to improve data quality, reporting processes, automation, and integration of risk operations tools.
Identify and implement automation and reporting enhancements using Power Automate, Power Query, Power BI, and related tools.
Conduct adverse impact analyses as requested and summarize findings for leadership review.
Build automated tracking and reporting tools that integrate multiple data sources, streamline workflows, improve data integrity, and enable real-time reporting.

Health & Safety

Oversee management of health and safety procedures and policies, including infectious disease and workplace violence safety programs
Monitor ongoing regulatory updates including OSHA standards, injury and illness prevention programs and government contractor compliance
Assist with real-time response during crisis matters such as natural disasters, including drafting employee-facing communications and compiling resources for impacted employees

The ideal candidate will be:

A business‑minded HR Risk &Compliance professional who excels at statistical workplace analysis, internal/external HR compliance, project and process management with impeccable planning, coordination, and follow‑through.
Operationally rigorous, detail‑accurate, and deadline‑reliable in a fast‑moving, matrixed environment.
Analytical, comfortable with metrics and translating data into clear executive summaries , timelines, and stakeholder guidance.
A concise, audience‑aware communicator who can write, edit, and sequence communications that drive clarity and action.
A strong collaborator across Legal/Compliance, People & Culture, Technology/HRIS, People Experience and Inclusion teams; adept at role clarity and RACI management.
Comfortable and integrity driven professional with experience in handling highly confidential information, sound judgment, and executive‑facing professionalism.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess:

6–8 years of progressive experience in HR Compliance, HR program management, PMO/operations, or organizational effectiveness (professional services experience a plus).
Hands‑on experience building and managing complex program plans (e.g., Smartsheet), SOPs, process documentation, and trainings.
Advanced data and reporting skills (Excel/Power BI or similar) Experience with Power Queries, look-ups, pivot tables and experience supporting various systems
Proficiency with MS Office, SharePoint/Teams, and content maintenance on intranet site.
Strong written and verbal communication; experience drafting broad‑reach communications, policies, FAQs, research papers and leader talking points and briefings.
HR regulatory reporting experience
People management experience preferred.

The base salary range for this position is between $112,000 and $160,000. Placement within the pay range is at Grant Thornton’s discretion, and it is based on multiple factors, including but not limited to, job -related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, progression within the role, geographic location, and internal equity. Careers

Business Intelligence Analyst

North Little Rock, Arkansas

Position Overview

We are seeking a motivated Business Intelligence Analyst to join our growing analytics team. This role is designed for someone who is eager to build hands-on experience with modern data visualization and analytics tools on real infrastructure projects.

Working under the direction of senior developers and the Business Analytics Manager, you will help build and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards, prepare and validate data from a variety of source systems, and support client deliverables. We are looking for strong fundamentals, attention to detail, and genuine curiosity.

Key Responsibilities

Report and Dashboard Development

Build and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards under the direction of senior team members, following established team standards for data modeling and design.
Write and troubleshoot SQL queries to extract, join, and validate data from client and internal source systems.
Assist in developing data models, measures, and calculated columns using DAX and Power Query.
Apply design principles for layout, color, and readability so dashboards are clear, intuitive, and consistent with Garver standards.
Support ongoing maintenance of existing reports, including scheduled refreshes, issue resolution, and enhancement requests.

Data Preparation and Quality

Gather, clean, transform, and validate data from multiple sources, including spreadsheets, databases, ERP systems, project management platforms, and GIS data.
Perform quality checks to confirm the accuracy and integrity of data and calculations before deliverables go to review.
Document data sources, transformation logic, assumptions, and known limitations.
Identify data discrepancies and anomalies, raise them promptly, and help research root causes.

Project and Client Support

Complete assigned project tasks within budgeted hours and schedule, tracking your own progress and communicating status and obstacles early.
Participate in requirements gathering sessions and client working meetings, capturing notes and documenting requests.
Assist in preparing materials for client presentations, program reporting, and training sessions.
Coordinate with engineering staff and project managers to understand the data behind the deliverable.

Learning and Development

Build technical skills through mentoring, structured training, certifications, and hands-on project experience.
Learn Garver's markets — transportation, aviation, water, buildings, and federal — and how analytics supports infrastructure planning and delivery.
Contribute to team knowledge sharing, standards documentation, and process improvement ideas.
Stay current on business intelligence and data visualization best practices.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
1–3 years of professional experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a related role. Internships, co-ops, and substantial academic or personal projects count.
Working knowledge of Power BI or a comparable data visualization tool such as Tableau.
Foundational SQL skills, including the ability to write and modify queries with joins, filters, and aggregations.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and working with large data sets.
Strong attention to detail and a habit of checking your own work.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to ask good questions and explain what you built.
Ability to take direction, manage assigned deadlines, and collaborate as part of a project team.
Curiosity and a demonstrated willingness to learn new tools and subject matter.

Preferred Qualifications

Project experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or reporting.
Experience with DAX and Power Query/M.
Exposure to data modeling concepts such as star schemas, relationships, and dimensional design.
Familiarity with Python, R, or another scripting language for data preparation and analysis.
Exposure to GIS tools such as ArcGIS, or interest in geospatial data.
Interest in the civil engineering and infrastructure industry, particularly transportation, aviation, or water.
An eye for graphic design and data storytelling.
Familiarity with descriptive and diagnostic analytics, and interest in growing toward predictive and prescriptive work.

Grow With Us

Garver provides the tools, resources, and environment to develop leaders, stimulate ideas, and accomplish projects. Alpine Business Consulting is looking for a Data Analyst Assistant to support our ongoing project with an Antwerp-based logistics client. In this entry-level role, you will work alongside our consultants to maintain the integrity of financial data within Enterprise Performance Management systems. The position is fully remote, allowing you to contribute to complex international projects from your own workspace.

About Alpine Business Consulting

Alpine Business Consulting works at the intersection of finance processes and the systems that support them. We specialize in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) and analytics, helping finance teams fix platforms that never delivered on their promises. While we build new systems from scratch, much of our work involves remediating existing setups in Oracle EPM, SAP BPC, and Power BI. We focus on the numbers side of the house, ensuring that consolidation rules, intercompany eliminations, and reporting pipelines reflect how a finance team actually operates.
Our approach moves away from typical implementation theatre. We prioritize finance-first configurations and fixed-price engagements, giving our clients certainty before any work begins. We do not believe in keeping clients dependent on us. Instead, we build administrator training and documentation into every project so teams can run their systems independently after go-live. We are a remote-first team of consultants who understand that a dashboard is only useful if the data is accurate to the cent and available the morning a period closes. Whether it is a cloud migration or a complex forecasting model, we value precision over presentation.

What You Will Do
Organize and clean large datasets from logistics operations to ensure they are ready for financial consolidation.
Assist consultants in verifying that intercompany eliminations are calculated correctly within the EPM software.
Run daily data validation checks to compare system outputs against source files and spreadsheets.
Help build and maintain basic reporting templates in Power BI to track key performance indicators for the client.
Document system configuration steps so that client administrators can understand how their data flows.
Support the testing phase of new system updates by identifying discrepancies in financial reports.
Collaborate with the team through digital channels to resolve data entry errors or mapping issues.

What We Are Looking For
A basic understanding of accounting or finance principles, such as balance sheets and profit and loss statements.
Strong familiarity with Microsoft Excel, including the use of formulas to organize data.
Technical curiosity and an interest in learning how enterprise software handles complex financial rules.
High attention to detail and a habit of double-checking work for accuracy.
The ability to work independently in a fully remote environment while staying in sync with a distributed team.
Clear communication skills to explain findings or issues discovered during data reviews.
Prior experience with data visualization tools or basic databases is helpful but not required for this level.

What We Offer
A permanent, full-time position with a fully remote work structure.
Practical experience working with enterprise-level tools like Oracle EPM, SAP, and Power BI.
Exposure to the inner workings of global logistics and finance operations.
Direct mentorship from senior consultants who value teaching and clear documentation.
A professional environment that prioritizes technical accuracy over corporate posturing.
Competitive pay that is attractive for an entry-level role in the current market.

How We Work

Our firm operates on the belief that consulting should provide clear, finished results. We use fixed-price contracts and well-defined scopes to ensure everyone knows what needs to be done. We do not use filler language or vague goals. Our team focuses on making sure that when we finish a project, the client has a system they can actually use and maintain. By working remotely, we stay efficient and focused on the technical requirements of the finance teams we serve. We expect every team member to value the precision of the numbers above all else.

Über den Bereich

PB Transformation verantwortet das globale Veränderungsportfolio der Private Bank. Wir sind weltweit tätig und in allen Regionen vertreten, in denen die Private Bank aktiv ist. Innerhalb unserer Organisation ist jede und jeder dazu befähigt, die Transformation im Einklang mit den strategischen Zielen von Business und Technology aktiv mitzugestalten und voranzutreiben, indem Innovation gefördert wird. Dabei nutzen wir modernste Technologien, um unsere Produkte und Prozesse zu modernisieren und die Art und Weise, wie wir unsere Kundinnen und Kunden betreuen, kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Werde Teil einer der derzeit bedeutendsten Transformationsinitiativen im Bankensektor. In dieser Rolle treibst Du große, komplexe, globale Veränderungsprogramme voran, die die Kundenreisen der Private Bank sowie die Prozesse im Middle- und Back-Office modernisieren. Ein besonderer Fokus liegt dabei auf KI-gestützten Fähigkeiten, digitalen Kanälen und der Integration in zentrale Kernbankensysteme. Die Projekte erstrecken sich über verschiedene Handlungsfelder unseres transformatorischen Target Operating Model Programms, darunter AI & Process Enablers, Channels, KYC, Daily Banking, Investment Services, Lending, Reporting & Data Management sowie Non-Product Processes.

Deine Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für eines von mehreren miteinander verknüpften Transformationsprojekten (z. B. die Erneuerung der Product Engine, Intelligent Transaction Processing oder vergleichbare Initiativen).
Du steuerst die Umsetzung strategischer Ziele im Einklang mit der übergreifenden Vision des Target Operating Models und übernimmst dabei klare Verantwortung, handelst eigenständig und sorgst für Transparenz gegenüber den relevanten Stakeholdern.
Du entwickelst Roadmaps und Umsetzungspläne, die konsequent auf konkrete Ergebnisse ausgerichtet, messbar und skalierbar für den bankweiten Einsatz sind.
Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Projektleitenden, Architekturverantwortlichen und Business-Sponsoren zusammen, um eine konsistente und abgestimmte Umsetzung über alle Programme hinweg sicherzustellen.
Du agierst in einem vernetzten Führungsumfeld, gestaltest und verantwortest dein eigenes Projekt und trägst gleichzeitig aktiv zum Erfolg der übergeordneten Transformationsinitiative bei.

Deine Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen

Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Betriebswirtschaft, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang oder einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation.
Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Technologie- und Transformationsinitiativen im Banken-, FinTech- oder Plattformumfeld mit.
Du hast umfassende Erfahrung in der Transformation des Private-Banking-Geschäfts und ein tiefes Verständnis der damit verbundenen Herausforderungen und Erfolgsfaktoren.
Du beherrschst agile, hybride und klassische Projekt- und Programmmanagementmethoden und setzt diese situationsgerecht ein.
Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Stakeholder-Management- und Einflussfähigkeiten und bewegst dich sicher auf Managementebene und kommunizierst verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und Englisch – sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

Wir bieten eine breite Palette von Leistungen, die all Ihre beruflichen und persönlichen Bedürfnisse abdecken.

Emotional ausgeglichen Eine positive Haltung hilft uns, die Herausforderungen des Alltags zu meistern – beruflich wie privat. Profitieren Sie von Angeboten wie Beratung in schwierigen Lebenssituationen und Angeboten zur Förderung mentaler Gesundheit.
Körperlich fit Mit Angeboten zur Aufrechterhaltung Ihrer persönlichen Gesundheit und einem förderlichen beruflichen Umfeld hilft Ihnen die Bank, körperlich fit zu bleiben. Profitieren Sie von Angeboten wie umfangreichen Check-up Untersuchungen, Impfangeboten und Beratung zur gesunden Lebensführung.
Sozial vernetzt Der Austausch mit anderen eröffnet uns neue Perspektiven, bringt uns beruflich wie persönlich voran und stärkt unser Selbstvertrauen und Wohlbefinden. Profitieren Sie von Angeboten wie Unterstützung durch den pme Familienservice, das FitnessCenter Job, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle (bspw. Teilzeit, Jobtandem, hybrides Arbeiten) sowie einer umfangreichen Kultur der Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit und Teilhabe.
Finanziell abgesichert Die Bank sichert Sie nicht nur während Ihrer aktiven Karriere, sondern auch für die Zukunft finanziell ab und unterstützt Ihre Flexibilität sowie Mobilität – egal ob privat oder beruflich. Profitieren Sie von Angeboten wie Beitragsplänen für Altersvorsorge, Bankdienstleistungen für Mitarbeiter*innen, Firmenfahrrad oder dem Deutschlandticket.

Da die Benefits je nach Standort geringfügig variieren, gehen Sie bitte bei konkreten Fragen auf Ihren Recruiter / Ihre Recruiterin zu.

Die Stelle wird in Voll- und in Teilzeit angeboten.

Bei Fragen zum Rekrutierungsprozess steht Ihnen Vanessa Lips gerne zur Verfügung.

Kontakt Vanessa Lips: +49 69 910-34272

Gemeinsam teilen und feiern wir die Erfolge unserer Mitarbeiter*innen. Gemeinsam sind wir die Deutsche Bank Gruppe.

Job Summary

Within SHI, the Spend Optimization Services (SOS) organization is transforming how customers manage and optimize technology investments by connecting strategy, financial accountability, and operational execution to deliver measurable business outcomes.

The Sr. Program Analyst - Transformation supports the execution and continuous improvement of the Revenue Intelligence portfolio while contributing to broader transformation initiatives across the organization. This role partners with technical development teams, business stakeholders, and leadership to translate business needs into actionable requirements, manage delivery workflows, and drive operational excellence.

While primarily focused on the Revenue Intelligence development lifecycle, this position will also support go-to-market (GTM) initiatives, service lifecycle efforts, organizational communications, and other strategic programs as business priorities evolve.

Lead stakeholder workshops and working sessions across Spend Optimization Services (SOS) to gather business requirements, KPI definitions, thresholds, continuous improvement opportunities, and business rules; translate findings into user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlog items.
Partner with development and business teams to refine requirements, support execution efforts, and maintain traceability from requirements through delivery to measurable business outcomes.
Develop and maintain project plans across SOS initiatives while tracking roadmap priorities, milestones, delivery commitments, cross-functional dependencies, and intake evaluation and prioritization activities.
Execute and help scale the Revenue Intelligence operating model, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, prioritization sessions, mid-sprint reviews, demonstrations, and release readiness coordination.
Apply consistent delivery practices across SOS initiatives and identify opportunities to standardize and improve execution models across teams.

Business Analysis: Translate business needs into structured requirements and user stories
Project / Program Management: Manage multiple concurrent initiatives across analytics, GTM, and service domains

Go-to-Market Awareness: Familiarity with enablement, pipeline tracking, and launch coordination

Organizational Communication: Ability to distill complex initiatives into clear, concise messaging for different audiences
Tooling & Systems: Experience with Asana (preferred) and reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, Excel)
Communication & Facilitation: Strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills
Adaptability & Prioritization: Evaluate competing priorities and provide structured recommendations supported by data, business context, and stakeholder input
Change Management: Ability to drive meaningful change through influence

Skill Level Requirements

Business analysis and requirements gathering.
Ability to translate business needs into structured requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Program and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives.
Process design and service lifecycle management capabilities.
Knowledge of agile or iterative delivery methodologies.
Go-to-market awareness, including enablement, pipeline tracking, launch coordination, and campaign execution.

Experience supporting application development, business intelligence, transformation, and service lifecycle initiatives.
Experience creating executive communications, stakeholder-facing summaries, enablement materials, and release communications.
Experience using project delivery, collaboration, and reporting tools.
Ability to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Experience supporting cross-functional transformation initiatives involving technical, business, and leadership stakeholders to align priorities, clarify requirements, coordinate execution, and deliver measurable outcomes.

Preferred

Who We Are:

Beacon Healthcare Systems Inc. is an exciting software as a service (SaaS) company thriving in the healthcare space. We provide compliance and regulatory software modules for applicable stakeholders in the health insurance industry.

Why Work Here?

Bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions in a mission critical healthcare compliance platform.
Work directly with stakeholders, engineers, and product teams to shape how the product evolves.
Make a tangible impact in a fast-growing SaaS company where your analysis drives real decisions.
Competitive compensation, remote flexibility, and a collaborative culture that values curiosity and rigor.

Role:
Business Analyst

Location:
Remote

Compensation:
$85,000 - $97,000 per year plus benefits and bonus

Description:

Our ideal candidate is an experienced Business Analyst who excels at gathering, documenting, and translating complex business requirements into actionable technical specifications. You have a natural ability to bridge the communication gap between business stakeholders and engineering teams, and you bring a structured, analytical approach to problem-solving. You are detail oriented, intellectually curious, and energized by the challenge of improving processes and products in a regulated healthcare environment. This role plays a critical part in supporting new product implementations, client deployments, and coordinated release activities. This position reports to the Director of Implementations.

Responsibilities:

Requirements Gathering & Documentation

Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements through interviews, workshops, surveys, and process observation with stakeholders across the organization.
Translate business needs into clear, detailed functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flow diagrams.
Maintain and manage a requirements repository, ensuring traceability from business need through to delivery and testing.

Process Analysis & Improvement

Analyze existing business processes, workflows, and systems to identify inefficiencies, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
Develop as is and to be process maps, gap analyses, and business cases to support technology investment and process change decisions.
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure solutions are technically feasible, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Serve as the primary liaison between client business stakeholders and the engineering and product teams throughout the project lifecycle.
Facilitate requirements review sessions, design walkthroughs, and user acceptance testing (UAT) with business owners.
Communicate project progress, requirement changes, and risk implications clearly to all relevant stakeholders.

Quality & Delivery Support

Support new product implementations by documenting and implementing client specific configuration needs, integration requirements, and deployment considerations.
Partner with and support client deployments including validation and troubleshooting.
Participate in release planning and coordination ensuring new features are properly documented, tested, and aligned to client deployment schedules.
Support QA teams by reviewing test plans and test cases to ensure alignment with documented requirements and acceptance criteria.
Participate in sprint ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and sprint reviews in an Agile development environment.
Produce post implementation reviews and lessons learned documentation to drive continuous improvement.

Education and Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
Minimum 5 -10 years of business analysis experience in a SaaS, technology, or healthcare IT environment.
Proven ability to gather and document complex business requirements and translate them into technical user stories and functional specifications.
Strong proficiency with business analysis tools and techniques including process mapping, use case development, and gap analysis.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments; familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills; ability to lead workshops and present findings to executive stakeholders.
CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) or PMI-PBA certification preferred.
Experience in healthcare, insurance, or regulated software environments is a strong plus.

Personal Competencies:

Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to deconstruct complex problems and identify root causes.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to tailor messaging to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
Detail oriented with a commitment to accuracy, consistency, and completeness in all documentation.
Collaborative and relationship-driven; able to build trust with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Self-starter who manages workload effectively, meets deadlines, and adapts well to shifting priorities.

Your scope will span business and financial administration, executive operations, inventory and ecommerce, showroom and client experience, and special projects.
We are looking for someone who doesn't simply execute tasks, but creates structure, identifies what needs attention, follows through across multiple stakeholders, and takes ownership of getting things done.
Because M'RHEN is a small and growing company, there is no hierarchy of tasks. You should be equally comfortable preparing financial reports, coordinating with an accountant or production partner, managing a VIP client request, organizing the founder's international travel, or preparing the showroom ahead of an appointment.
For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to become a trusted operating partner to the founder while gaining firsthand exposure to the commercial, financial, creative, and operational decisions involved in building a luxury fashion house.

BUSINESS & FINANCIAL OPERATIONS

Maintain day-to-day financial visibility across the business, including expense tracking, receipt management, accounts payable and receivable, reconciliations, and cash-flow reporting.
Coordinate vendor payments, client invoicing, and payment follow-up.
Maintain organized financial records and liaise with the brand's external accountant on bookkeeping, tax preparation, reporting, and related financial administration.
Work with production and the founder to maintain visibility into production costs, margins, inventory value, and collection-level spending.
Prepare financial and operational information to support the founder's budgeting, cash-planning, and collection-planning decisions.
Coordinate payroll, insurance, business filings, and basic HR and compliance administration.
Build and maintain operational systems for expenses, inventory, reporting, documentation, and internal communication.
Identify operational gaps and proactively implement better processes as the company grows.

EXECUTIVE & FOUNDER OPERATIONS

Manage the founder's calendar, appointments, meetings, and daily priorities, anticipating needs and protecting the founder's time.
Coordinate domestic and international travel, itineraries, reservations, and transportation with precision.
Handle personal errands and administrative needs with discretion and follow-through.
Maintain organization across documents, contracts, receipts, records, and internal systems.
Liaise with factories, freelancers, PR teams, stylists, consultants, and external partners on behalf of the founder.
Track key follow-ups, deadlines, and outstanding decisions across the business, ensuring priorities move forward.
Prepare materials, information, and briefings needed for meetings and decision-making.
Support day-to-day operational needs and special priorities as they arise.

INVENTORY & ECOMMERCE OPERATIONS

Oversee accurate and timely fulfillment of ecommerce and client orders.
Maintain visibility into studio inventory, garment movements, and stock levels.
Maintain accurate inventory records and flag discrepancies or low-stock positions.
Coordinate sample trafficking, messenger pickups, shipments, returns, and inventory transfers.
Coordinate with studio and production partners to ensure garments and samples are where they need to be.
Support Shopify and other ecommerce operations and workflows as needed.

SHOWROOM & CLIENT EXPERIENCE

Manage and service showroom appointments with warmth, professionalism, discretion, and a strong eye for styling.
Serve as a first point of contact for VIP clients and custom-order inquiries, gathering details, communicating timelines, and escalating decisions to the founder when appropriate.
Communicate with clients via email and phone with exceptional care and precision.
Support gifting, hospitality, alterations, special orders, and order coordination to maintain an elevated client experience.
Maintain showroom presentation, including merchandising, steaming, organization, and restocking.
Support trunk shows, pop-ups, photoshoots, market appointments, and other brand events.

SPECIAL PROJECTS

As a close operating partner to the founder, the Executive & Business Operations Manager will support projects that fall outside a traditional job description. These may include research, vendor sourcing, events, new operational systems, market preparation, client initiatives, and other priorities that arise as the company grows.
The ability to take an ambiguous problem, determine what needs to happen, and drive it toward completion is essential.

QUALIFICATIONS

2–4 years of relevant professional experience; experience in fashion, luxury, retail, hospitality, or another highly detail-oriented environment strongly preferred.
Prior experience supporting a founder, entrepreneur, executive, or creative leader is a strong plus.
Strong operational instincts and demonstrated ability to create structure, maintain systems, and follow projects through to completion.
Comfortable working with numbers and financial information, with a working knowledge of bookkeeping, AP/AR, reconciliations, and basic financial reporting.
Experience with QuickBooks or similar accounting software is a plus.
Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
High level of discretion, judgment, and professionalism; comfortable handling sensitive business, financial, client, and personal information.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong client-facing presence and comfort interacting with high-end clientele and senior external partners.
A critical eye for garments, presentation, fit, and styling.
Proactive, resourceful, and calm under pressure, with the instinct to identify what needs to happen rather than waiting to be assigned every task.
Comfortable moving fluidly between high-level and hands-on responsibilities.
Familiarity with Shopify, Google Workspace, Notion, Airtable, or similar platforms is a plus.
Based in New York City with flexibility for occasional evenings and weekends during events, shoots, and market periods.

WHO WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE

You may be a particularly strong fit if you naturally notice what is missing, create a system for it, and follow through without needing repeated direction.
You are interested not only in fashion, but in how a fashion business actually works
. You want exposure to the decisions behind product, clients, operations, finance, production, PR, and growth—and you are willing to do the detailed work required to understand them.
You are comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial environment where priorities can shift quickly and no two days look exactly the same. You enjoy being close to the action, operating with a high level of trust, and becoming increasingly valuable as you develop a deeper understanding of the founder and the business.

EXECUTIVE & FOUNDER OPERATIONS

Please send a brief introduction and your resume to info@m-rhen.com
with the subject line “Executive & Business Operations Manager — M'RHEN.”

In your introduction, please tell us briefly why you are interested in working inside an emerging luxury fashion company and share one example of a time you took ownership of a problem without being told exactly how to solve it.
We review applications on a rolling basis and will be in touch with candidates whose experience aligns closely with the role.

Imaging Endpoints (IE) is an Imaging Technology and Imaging Clinical Research Organization (iCRO). We are passionately focused on our vision to Connect Imaging to the CureTM . Everything we do is aligned with this singular purpose. We work every day excited to advance imaging science, technology, and services to bring curative technologies to humankind. We have supported many of the most impactful new drug approvals in oncology, and we are seeking the most talented individuals globally that are passionate in their desire to assist us in our mission to customize each clinical trial’s imaging to optimize the opportunity to demonstrate efficacy.

Imaging Endpoints is based in Scottsdale, Arizona, with offices in Cambridge, Massachusetts; London, UK; Leiden, Netherlands; Basel, Switzerland; Hyderabad, India and Shanghai, China. We are an affiliate of HonorHealth, one of the largest healthcare systems nationally, and Scottsdale Medical Imaging Limited (SMIL/RadPartners), the largest private radiology group in the United States. We are recognized as the world’s largest and most preeminent iCRO in oncology.

Under the direction of Imaging Operations/Project Management Leadership this position is responsible to work with sponsors to manage timelines, deliverables, and resources, liaise with the appropriate staff to complete work as detailed in the client’s contract and/or work order, and to effectively communicate project status and escalating issues with all internal and external stakeholders.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Execute project deliverables for imaging studies in clinical trials in accordance with project scope of work and within sponsor specified timelines;
Manage day-to-day operational aspects of a clinical imaging projects;
Assist in preparation and adherence to imaging trial documents i.e. Image Review Charter, Imaging Manual, Data Transmittal Forms, etc;
Ensure project documents are complete, current, and stored appropriately;
Manage key project documents/processes, i.e. Project Management Plan, Communication Plan, Escalation Plan, Risk Management Plan and appropriate Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS);
Identify resources needed and assign individual responsibilities;
Identify out of scope requests and work with appropriate team(s) to revise the work order to meet changing needs and requirements;
Review and manage all deliverables;
Prepare metrics reporting for client and senior management;
Prepare forecasting information for Finance purposes;
Perform other duties as assigned by the Supervisor

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent certification in a health related field
Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Quality Assurance/Compliance in a clinical trials setting is required
Knowledge of key project management documents and tools a must
Prior experience with different EDC systems required
Proficiency in MS Office and internet applications required
Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in the clinical trials industry required
Minimum of 2 years of experience in medical imaging in a clinical trial environment required
Experience managing global Phase III clinical trials with imaging components strongly preferred
PMP certification a plus

SKILLS

Proficiency in MS Office and internet applications
Service-oriented approach, flexible, and proactive toward adapting to client needs
Ability to manage project activities with diverse group and individuals with little supervision
Must have superior attention to detail including excellent oral and written communication skills.
Must have the ability to work independently, multitask, and meet critical timelines under pressure
Must have strong time management and organization skills
Self-driven, ability to get the job done with little supervision, can-do positive attitude
Ability to excel in a team environment
Ability to work in strict compliance with all procedures, rules, and regulations
Maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive data, records, files, conversations, etc.
Must be self-motivated and able to grasp new concepts quickly
Ability to prioritize workload to the changing needs of the day-to-day business
Ability to understand technical research protocols and successfully lead within the research environment

IMAGING ENDPOINTS’ TEAM CHARACTERISTICS

Passion to Connect Imaging to the CureTM and pursue a meaningful career by improving the lives of cancer patients through imaging
Strong desire to be part of a dynamic, global team working closely together and growing year after year in a rewarding environment to help humanity through imaging
Commitment and caring for our fellow team members, their families, and the communities IE serves - see more information about Caring Endpoints at https://caringendpoints.org/
Integrity and high ethical standards; we always do the right thing
High intellect and ingenuity; we enjoy solving problems, finding a better way, and the challenge of making a difference by improving lives
Structured, organized, detail-oriented, and self-motivated; we approach each day with a detailed plan and excitement to accomplish the day’s objectives while striving to improve ourselves and IE

Communicate clear prioritization of AUTA's most pressing problems/needs and ensuring tech teams design solutions meet diverse user persona needs
Create and maintain comprehensive project information, driving crisp decisions and clear communication of progress, timelines, and escalations to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
Define, monitor, and analyze key performance metrics to identify optimization opportunities, proactively mitigate risks before they become roadblocks, and ensure solutions improve operational efficiency across the global recruitment lifecycle

You'll partner closely with AUTA teams and customers to understand their unique use cases and challenges, then collaborate with technical teams to ensure solutions align with operational and business needs. AURA works within AUTA, Amazon's central campus hiring organization who support recruiting efforts across all streams, most countries, and over 150 roles. Position Description

CGI Federal is currently seeking an experienced Robotic Process Automation (RPA) Analyst to support a large Department of Homeland Security program.

This role will primarily focus on front end RPA/automation analysis, including conducting discovery sessions with DHS customers, mapping processes, identifying automation candidates, assessing feasibility, and translating operational challenges into clear requirements. The role partners with an existing RPA developer who handles build and deployment.

You will help determine whether something should be automated — not necessarily build the automation yourself.

This position is located in one of CGI Federal's offices in Fairfax, VA, Lebanon, VA, Lafayette, LA or Knoxville, TN; however, a hybrid working model is acceptable. You will be required to work in a CGI Federal office two days per week.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Conduct discovery sessions with DHS stakeholders to understand processes, pain points, and opportunities
Perform automation assessments including feasibility, complexity scoring, and value analysis
Document current state and future state workflows
Translate operational needs into clear, concise requirements
Work with the RPA developer to hand off validated, well defined automation candidates
Identify creative, innovative solutions to improve efficiency and reduce manual workloads
Support light testing and validation of automated solutions
Partner with business and technical teams to ensure accurate understanding of requirements

Due to government contract and clearance requirements, U.S. citizenship and successful completion of a CGI background check are required.
3–5 years in business analysis, process analysis, or workflow optimization
Experience conducting discovery sessions and eliciting requirements from non technical stakeholders
Familiarity with RPA concepts (not necessarily deep development experience)
Experience evaluating processes for automation potential
Strong communication skills and comfort leading discussions with federal stakeholders
Ability to travel to client sites as needed.

new_jobs.description:
Georgetown University comprises two unique campuses in the nation’s capital. With the Hilltop Campus located in the heart of the historic Georgetown neighborhood, and the Capitol Campus, just minutes from the U.S. Capitol and U.S. Supreme Court, Georgetown University offers rigorous academic programs, a global perspective, and unparalleled opportunities to engage with Washington, D.C. Our community is a close-knit group of remarkable individuals driven by intellectual inquiry, a commitment to social justice, and a shared dedication to making a difference in the world.

Requirements

Job Overview

The Office of Human Subject Protections (OHSP) is responsible for the review of all research activities that involve human subjects in accordance with federal regulations. The OHSP operations analyst will work under the direction of the Senior Director of the OHSP to manage the administrative functions necessary for the successful operations of the office. These functions include being the first point of contact for the OHSP offices, Email management, operational meeting agendas and minutes, administrative management of IRB membership, IRB account creation and trouble-shooting, paper and electronic file management, website development and management, carrying out financial functions (IRB charge back and tracking, expense approvals, supply ordering), coordination of the compilation of OHSP metrics for required reporting, general correspondence, create and publish public communication, and assist in managing office HR actions. Additionally assist in account management of HURON, CITI and others as needed.

Work Interactions

The Office of Human Subject Protections serves as the official oversight office for human subject research activities at Georgetown University. The Office of Human Subject Protections reports to the Medical Center Vice President (VP) for Research and the Vice Provost of Research for the Main Campus. The OHSP program coordinator reports directly to the Senior Director of the OHSP. They will serve to assist both the Office of Research Quality Assurance and the Institutional Review Board that fall under the OHSP. The position will interact with the research community as the first point of contact for the office and will assist in creating and publishing any public facing materials and communication. As such, this position requires someone with collaborative and concise verbal and written communication skills. The program coordinator will engage directly with the staff in OHSP on a daily basis to triage incoming communication. The individual in the position will be a critical member of the OHSP to ensure efficient operations.

Requirements And Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and 2-3 years of experience in operational management skills
Experience demonstrating highly effective communications skills and ability to work on multiple projects.
Computer proficiency is required, including MS Word, Excel, internet browsers, and email.
Basic financial management skills
Experience using video meeting and scheduling platforms.

Masters in health care management, business or certificate in project management
Previous experience in administrative position
Website management
Familiarity with IRB/research software platforms

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organisation makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe building engineering is more than systems and structures, it’s about powering progress and enabling innovation. As part of HDR’s Building Engineering Services Group, you’ll help design the critical infrastructure that supports the digital age and shapes the spaces where people work, connect, and thrive. From high-performance data centres driving the future of AI to dynamic commercial environments, your work will directly support technological advancement, sustainability, and human experience. We bring together mechanical, electrical, structural, and civil engineering experts to solve complex design challenges with precision, creativity, and collaboration. Whether you're optimizing energy efficiency, integrating resilient systems, or engineering the backbone of next-generation facilities, your contributions will help define the future of the built environment. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead innovation, engineer impact, and build a legacy of excellence.

About The Role

As a Senior Project Manager, you will take lead for the successful delivery and commercial performance of complex multidisciplinary projects and programmes. You will provide leadership to project teams, manage strategic client relationships, oversee project governance and ensure delivery of technical, programme and commercial objectives. You will act as a senior representative of the business, leading project delivery strategy, supporting business growth and ensuring projects contribute positively to operational and financial performance. In addition, you will mentor project managers and contribute to the development and continuous improvement of project delivery practices across the business

About You

We are seeking a Senior Project Manager with demonstrable leadership experience managing multidisciplinary project teams across complex projects and programmes. Someone with strong commercial awareness with the ability to balance technical, operational and financial priorities, with proven ability to influence, negotiate and build consensus across clients, stakeholders and project teams. You will have a strong decision-making and problem-solving capability within complex delivery environments and experience in developing and mentoring project managers and technical professionals.

Responsibilities

Support the Area Business Group Manager and leadership team in the effective operation and strategic development of the business.
Promote and champion the implementation of HDR project management, commercial, quality and risk management processes.
Contribute to business planning activities including workload forecasting, resource planning and operational improvement initiatives.
Support the development, mentoring and performance management of Project Managers and project delivery staff.
Participate in recruitment, talent development, succession planning and retention activities as required.
Encourage technical excellence, innovation and adoption of best practice across all project teams.
Provide support and guidance in project reviews, project recovery plans and resolution of complex delivery challenges.
Contribute to bid reviews, project pursuits and mobilisation activities for major opportunities.
Promote collaboration across business groups, disciplines and geographic regions to maximise value for clients and the business.
Support the continuous development of project management standards, procedures, templates and lessons learned programmes.
Undertake project audits, governance reviews and quality assurance activities as required.
Ensure compliance with HDR Quality Management Systems, environmental management procedures and all applicable company policies.
Champion a culture of safety, integrity, accountability and continuous improvement.
Represent HDR professionally within industry forums, client organisations and professional institutions.
Perform other duties as required to support the successful operation and growth of the business.

Requirements

Degree qualified in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related discipline.
Minimum 10 years relevant industry experience, including significant experience delivering multidisciplinary engineering or consultancy projects.
Demonstrable experience in a Senior Project Manager leadership role.
Professional registration or chartership in a relevant discipline (CEng, IEng or equivalent) preferred.
Project management qualification such as APM PMQ, ChPP, PMP or equivalent desirable.
Proven track record of managing complex projects with responsibility for technical, programme and commercial performance.
Experience managing projects through all phases of the project lifecycle from bid through delivery and closeout.
Experience of contract administration, commercial management and change control processes.
Experience of leading multidisciplinary teams and managing external consultants and contractors.
Commitment to continuous professional development and active participation in HDR's employee-owned culture.

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.
